answer: Written in a pragmatic engineering perspective, trade-offs first register, it stays short. The design leans on game-theoretic equilibrium in agent coordination. Reaching the orchard of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The lotus holds work receipts rather than names, so the grove of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
